email.subject1: a signal play for Treasure AI
email.body1:
Amir, saw Treasure Data rebranded to Treasure AI and launched the agentic experience platform plus Treasure Code.

A platform shift like that usually means more marketers and data teams evaluating you than reps can cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold in the West. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Treasure AI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Amir, quick follow-up for Treasure AI.

During a major platform launch, demand often outpaces the West team's ability to follow up. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your West region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Amir, last bit of proof for Treasure AI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Treasure AI's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Amir, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling West pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and I know a platform relaunch keeps you busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region? I will tailor it to Treasure AI either way.
